descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Telecomunicații și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
How would you like to work in IT, toying with cutting edge technologies and enjoying your life? At Orange Services, it’s possible!
 As one of the largest IT Hub within Orange Group, we are working internationally for both Orange corporate functions and country operations. Through a unique combination of know-how and expertise, our teams provide a broad range of IT & Business Solutions.
 Come closer to #LifeAtOrange!
 What are we looking for 
 We’re looking for a senior full-stack engineer with real depth in both frontend and backend, and a solid grip on data, infrastructure, and production.
 You’ll work closely with our architect and our engineering manager, who also acts as Scrum Master and Product Owner. Together, we work directly with stakeholders from other teams, departments, and entities, so you’ll be in the room when decisions get made.
 This is a senior role. We need someone who has already done this work, not someone growing into it.
 What you’ll be doing 
Building and shipping features across the whole stack, from the database to the UI
Shaping the architecture with our architect, and improving data processing and automation
Working with stakeholders to understand what they need, estimate the work, and flag problems early
Owning the quality of what you ship, including how it runs in production
Growing through a personal development plan, courses, and conferences
 What you’ll need to know/have 
You’ve owned complex systems end to end in enterprise environments, and other engineers come to you when things get hard
Strong backend skills in Java (Spring Boot) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic)
Serious frontend skills in JavaScript, HTML, and Vue.js . Strong React or Angular works too. Vue is quick to pick up.
Solid database skills, relational and NoSQL. Depending on the project, we use PostgreSQL , MongoDB, and Redis.
System design that holds up in production: scalability, security, and observability
Comfortable with cloud, Docker, and CI/CD
Experience explaining technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders, and pushing back clearly and respectfully when something won’t work
Fluent English. French is a plus.
 What about AI? 
 Part of our work is AI: agentic workflows, RAG , agentic RAG, and knowledge graphs. We build them with Pydantic AI, Spring AI, LangChain , LangGraph, and Deep Agents.
 You should know how these systems work. You don’t need to be fluent in them yet. If you’ve already built them, even better.
 What’s in it for you: 
Performance Bonuses – based on your results & the company’s; 
Electronic Meal Tickets 
Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too; 
#WFH & Flexible hours; 
Professional GSM subscription; 
Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!]; 
Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services; 
Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring; 
Wellbeing Programs – we support your Zen; 
 Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology. 
 Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development. 
 At Orange, you can. 
 IMPORTANT 
 In order to be able to follow your application status and receive relevant notifications, make sure to complete your application in our ATS (applicant tracking system), by following the redirection link. Once this step is completed, you will receive a confirmation email from Orange that your application has been successfully registered. 
 We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
